title: WebCMD
body:
![WebCMD visual description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/817c8fc9ec689b57f73ccc9c344c476abaed7fe1.png) **[PlayerCONSOLE](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%9C%A8%E3%80%90%E2%98%85-player%E2%9C%A6console-%E2%98%85%E3%80%91%E2%9C%A8-%E2%8E%AE-remote-panel-50-off-%E2%8E%AE-auto-restart-velocity-file-db-managing-api.126241/) is REQUIRED!**
Text Version WebCMD is a lightweight PlayerCONSOLE module that runs a persistent web panel on your machine. When Minecraft goes offline the panel stays up - so you can fire a start command from any browser and bring it back. Server went down? Open a browser on your phone or laptop, hit Run, it's back. No one needs to be at the machine. Controlled via PlayerCONSOLE Turn the panel on or off from inside the game using webcmd enable and webcmd disable. No files to edit, no restarts needed.
